decision.observation: Clicking the map deselected again; turn still 2; 'UNIT NEEDS ORDERS'. The Eagle Warrior red icon is at ~0.49,0.30, on the tile just north of the city near the lake. Crucially, this tile sits at the top edge of land, surrounded by lake to the north/west and the city's wheat tile to the east. The unit is essentially at the tip of a peninsula. The 2/2 movement persists but no land neighbors besides the city tile (which is the city itself, impassable for military). Wait—the wheat/gold tile east and grassland south should be passable.
decision.hypothesis: The '!' button at bottom-right (~0.94,0.86) is the End Turn / Next Turn. In Civ VI it's a large ornate circular button; when a unit has orders pending it selects the unit, but a second press when the unit is already selected/active may not end turn because the unit still has moves. Since we can't make the unit move, maybe the real issue is that clicking on the map emits a move but the game immediately sees the tile as the city and reselects/deselects. Try: select the unit, then click the unit's OWN current tile (should stay selected and offer move arrows), then click destination. Actually simpler: double-click a far destination tile to path-move.
decision.memory: Persistent decline. Try double-click on a distant land tile to issue a multi-turn move/path.
